settings.title: Settings
settings.savedLocally: These preferences are saved on this device and apply the next time you open the app.
settings.bilingualHelp: Show English assistance alongside Lao. Library content is not translated.
settings.installHelp: When the download-cloud icon appears in the top bar, select it to install. On iPhone or iPad, use Safari's Share menu and choose Add to Home Screen. Download collections before going offline.
settings.readingSizeHelp: Adjusts the base font size for chapter content across the app.
settings.presentationSizeHelp: Default slide text size. It can also be adjusted in Presentation mode.
settings.defaultRatioHelp: Aspect ratio used when a presentation starts. It can also be changed during a presentation.
settings.defaultThemeHelp: Background and text theme used when a presentation starts.
settings.defaultAlignmentHelp: Choose how content slide text is aligned.
settings.defaultFontHelp: Lao font used for slide text.
offline.title: Offline libraries
offline.help: Choose what is stored on this device. Downloaded libraries can be read and searched without a connection.
offline.downloadFailed: Could not download this library. Check your connection.
